summary: Lewis Hamilton faces a reckoning at Circuit of the Americas as Kimi Antonelli hunts the championship crown that slipped through Ferrari's grasp in Singapore. Carlos Sainz and the resurgent McLaren outfit circle the wounded Mercedes camp, seeking to capitalize on Hamilton's strategic misstep with aggressive pace and pit-wall precision. A victory for Antonelli would seal Ferrari's first drivers' championship since 2007, while any slip from the Italian teenager hands the title fight into a tighter three-way battle heading toward the season finale.
